purpose: Assistant-led expansion of maintenance-heavy facility buyers requested by owner: recovery/sober-living facilities, structured parking garages and casinos/gaming facilities.
safety: Inventory seed only. No outreach is staged or sent. Opportunity tags do not claim an unmet need. Government/tribal facilities may have procurement, licensing, insurance, sovereignty or vendor-registration requirements that BMC must respect.

commercial_service_hypotheses: commercial laundry / linen support where applicable
junk / bulk-item removal and turnover cleanup
